# AstroCast

> Free desktop astrology program for Windows and macOS by Steve Thornhill.
> It casts charts on the Swiss Ephemeris in the tropical zodiac, analyses
> them with the traditional and modern techniques of Western astrology, and
> writes every result out as a Markdown report that reads well on its own or
> as the input to an AI interpretation. A companion library of thirty prompts
> turns those reports into written readings, which the user can shape by
> adding context and a focus in the chart's Notes or in the request.

Current version: 1.7.1.
Requirements: Windows 10 or 11 (64-bit), or a Mac with Apple silicon running
macOS 15 or later.

## Downloads

- Windows installer: AstroCast_1.7.1.msi (73.9 MB)
- macOS disk image: AstroCast-v1.7.1-macOS-arm64.dmg (68.4 MB)
- Prompt library: AstroCast_Prompt_Library_2026-10-22.zip (1.0 MB)

All three are on the releases page:
https://github.com/sthornhill008/AstroCast/releases

## Pages

- [Download and overview](https://www.sthornhill.com/AstroCast/): downloads,
  first steps, the ten panels, checksums, common questions
- [Help](https://www.sthornhill.com/AstroCast/help/index.html): installing
  on Windows and on a Mac, the first chart and reading, the map key, common
  questions
- [Samples](https://www.sthornhill.com/AstroCast/samples/index.html): reports
  AstroCast wrote, each beside the reading an AI assistant made from
  it with a prompt of the prompt library. For two invented charts: a
  natal chart, a three-month transit timeline and a synastry. For a
  public figure: the primary directions from birth to age 43, and a
  reading that tests the published birth time against ten dated
  events. Each has a page of its own under samples/: natal-report,
  natal-reading, timeline-report, timeline-reading,
  rectification-report, rectification-reading, synastry-report,
  synastry-reading.
- [User Guide (PDF)](https://www.sthornhill.com/AstroCast/docs/AstroCast_User_Guide-v1.pdf)
- [Prompt Library Guide (PDF)](https://www.sthornhill.com/AstroCast/docs/AstroCast_Prompt_Library_Guide-v1.pdf)

## Facts

- Zodiac: tropical.
- House systems: Placidus (the default), Koch, Equal, Whole Sign,
  Regiomontanus, Campanus, Alcabitius, Porphyry, Morinus.
- Panels: Chart, Synastry, Transits, Returns, Relocate, Primary, Election,
  Medical, Map, Export. Each calculates on screen and exports what it shows.
- Dates: 1200 to 2399; dates before 15 October 1582 are read and printed on
  the Julian calendar.
- Saved charts: a database on the user's own computer. Beside the program on
  Windows (%LOCALAPPDATA%\Thornhill Computer Software\AstroCast); in
  ~/Library/Application Support/AstroCast on macOS.
- Internet use: the place lookup and the map's base-layer tiles only.
- Map background: CARTO tiles, which need a key the user supplies; public
  builds ship without one.
- Prompt library: thirty prompts, one per kind of export, written for
  Claude, ChatGPT and Copilot and for any assistant that reads a long
  instruction and a pasted document. The installers do not carry it. They
  are an aid to an astrologer, not a replacement for one.
- Licence: the program is under the GNU Affero General Public License,
  version 3 or later; the prompt library is under CC BY-SA 4.0.
- Source: https://github.com/sthornhill008/AstroCast
- Author: Steve Thornhill
